text:
ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green melon cubes, about 2.5 cm, smooth moist flesh with a slight sheen, three to four pieces clustered in the upper left, sitting partly on the greens | 40 g
ITEM 2 | Whole blueberries, dark navy to purple-black, glossy skin with a small crown at the top, about 1.2 cm each, roughly 20 berries in a loose cluster at the upper right | 30 g
ITEM 3 | Fresh strawberries, bright red, cut into slices and halves with white-tipped cores visible, moist, lying on the right side among the blueberries and the greens | 60 g
ITEM 4 | Cherry tomatoes, glossy red, one whole berry about 2.5 cm across plus a smaller piece beside it, on the left edge of the greens | 15 g
ITEM 5 | Fresh spinach-type leaves, dark green, crinkled and matte with a few lighter veins, forming a loose mound across the centre of the plate with no visible dressing | 40 g
ITEM 6 | Thin orange carrot shreds, bright orange, julienned strands about 5 to 6 cm long, scattered over and under the greens | 5 g
